intro: Burundi is one of the poorest countries in the world, relying on coffee and tea.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Coffee and tea make up most exports. Most people farm to feed their families. Fuel shortages have been a problem.

chapters.title: Minerals
text: Burundi has nickel and rare earth deposits.

cardGroups.title: Made in Burundi
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Burundi makes and sells to the world.
